reviews.title: 5 stars for the old version, new is bugged at least for me
reviews.text: I was excited to try the new workspace in the app, however, I’m not sure if it’s just my device but the selection feature is heavily broken for me. When I try selecting layers by pressing and holding the layer, it says they’re selected but no pink checkmark appears on them. Then, when I click the deselect button, the pink check marks appear. I also can’t copy or paste my selected frames, it just copies the single frame I was on when I hit the select button, not the others I tapped even though it says the number I’ve selected at the top. I also can’t move the frames I’ve selected, it just thinks I’m selecting more frames when I try to slide them somewhere else after selecting them. Sometimes when I’m selecting individual frames the selections just straight up cancel. The way I structure my animations relies heavily on being able to copy and paste large groups of frames, and select them smoothly. That’s why I really enjoyed the “select frames” menu in the previous version. This is disappointing, as I was excited to try and use the new features, but it looks like I’ll be sticking to the old version for now. Also yes, I did watch the tutorial for the new workspace, what’s shown there isn’t working the same for me in a lot of aspects.

reviews.title: Terrible.
reviews.text: I have some ocs, i love my ocs! When i heard there was an app to animate them and bring them to life, i was overjoyed. I started animating, and… what the heck. As soon as i opened a new animation i got a 30 second unskippable ad. I thought “oh maybe they need the money!” So i went on to animating. I began to draw and got to 3 layers and… what!? The max layers are 3. THREE. If you have ever drawn digitally, you know 3 layers is quite small. I kept getting popups for premium, which since i didn’t want to purchase anything (especially a subscription where i have to continuously pay), i didn’t buy it. I attempted making a very short animation with only 3 layers and wanted to add audio. PREMIUM, PREMIUM, PREMIUM. The heck!? Guess i have to edit audio on something else. Since i wasn’t very proud of my 2 second animation, i wanted to rotoscope. You know, make a meme! Haha! i went to import a quick video… PREMIUM. Now the app sucked. Basically, if you want to animate, you are blocked by a wall you cant climb, break or pass. The wall is called PREMIUM. I went to the flipaclip channel, do you guys even like animating? Heck, you guys have been using some ai in those videos! After all of this i quit animating all together, i bet a lot of people have. I’d much rather shove my head through a car door than make a 1 minute fluent animation of flipaclip without premium, if its even possible to. Terrible app.

Developers use the excuse of needing the money to pay expenses, which they have only talked about when called out for being money hungry.

If they truly needed money, they would have notified everyone beforehand.

For someone learning how to make animations for the first time, this is a great app (with the WIFI turned off.)

For someone with experience wanting to make a professional animation in any degree, use any other app.

reviews.title: fuming because of STUPID LAYER ISSUE
reviews.text: i was having a fantastic time animating; i was actually really happy with how it was turning out so far. i’d been doing it for quite a bit of time - around 2-3 hours - until i decided to insert a picture from my camera roll to use as a reference for the frame i was drawing on. after i was done with it, naturally, i deleted the photo layer. little did i know that deleting one singular layer was going to delete that same layer on EVERY. OTHER. FRAME. i’m fuming. i’ve lost all of my hard work and have zero patience to restart. i don’t understand why there is such an option for this in the first place, nor why, as much as i spammed the undo button, none of my work would come back. i beg of you to do something about this, because i am sure that this has happened to many other unfortunate souls like me who had no idea that deleting a layer on one frame would delete the same layer on all other frames. as i said before, i’m incredibly frustrated. thank you.
